parts.label: (c)
parts.answer: $2\mathbf i+\mathbf j-3\mathbf k$ or $-\frac13\mathbf i+\frac{10}{3}\mathbf j+\frac53\mathbf k$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State $\overrightarrow{OP}$ in component form - B1, FT. Form an equation in $\lambda$ by equating $|\overrightarrow{OP}|$ to $\sqrt{14}$, or equivalent - M1. Simplify to $3\lambda^2-\lambda-4=0$, or equivalent - A1; the scheme gives equivalent sign/parameter forms for alternative direction vectors. Solve a three-term quadratic and find a position vector - M1; for this parameterisation $\lambda=-1$ or $\frac43$. Obtain $2\mathbf i+\mathbf j-3\mathbf k$ and $-\frac13\mathbf i+\frac{10}{3}\mathbf j+\frac53\mathbf k$, or equivalent - A1; coordinates accepted. Printed total: 5.
